objective: Inventory every canonical registered sequence and every actual automation entrypoint across locally available repositories, classify current input construction, and derive the complete future no-argument shared-intake migration surface without editing or executing those operations.

candidate_contract.material_gaps: Unique non-empty finding IDs only. Use an empty array if no research-actionable gap remains.
candidate_contract.evidence_rule: Every material statement and every inventory row must cite stable evidence IDs that resolve to exact file and line or exact file anchors in evidence_index. Do not guess unavailable paths or interfaces.
candidate_contract.completeness_rule: The sequence-id set and count must exactly match the canonical registry. Explicitly include commit-push-main, taggable-api-deploy, taggable-admin-spa-deploy, and taggable-media-worker-deploy.

constraints: Read-only inspection only; do not edit repositories or execute operational entrypoints.
Do not expose secrets or inspect credential values.
Treat sub-sequences, MCP-backed operations, composed automation, and human-only steps as first-class inventory shapes rather than forcing each row into one-script form.
Separate deterministic intake construction from approval or effect authorization.
Do not infer that a no-argument help or default path is a compliant guided intake; verify question guidance and deterministic structure construction from code.
Do not omit a registry row because its repository key or display name differs from the local folder name.
